brief: orchestration/NEXT-DISPATCH.md §2b — the Act V conversation nobody wrote
findings: SHIPPED AND MEASURED: 12 topics, 36 infos, 3,637 authored words, 0 shadowed infos, 0 duplicate topic ids. Verified in the running build by tools/quests/act5-argument-probe.mjs (report: reports/runs/W1-17-ACT5-ARGUMENT.json).

MEASURED IN THE RUNNING BUILD (tools/quests/act5-argument-probe.mjs): 12 topics on ixtu-meer, 4 of them absent for a character carrying no flags and present once the six Act II/III/V flags are set; all 12 answers differ between an interior Saxhleel (disposition 74) and a lukiul Dunmer (0); `how the Count opens` is offered at every disposition including 0; the Recension answer is present above disposition 20 and the refusal below it, and the refusal does not leak the revelation.

TOPIC NAMESPACE DEFECT, PROJECT-WIDE. The quest layer writes topic keywords in prose ('the steward of the count' — 76 `opens_by.topic` values, and every main-quest NPC `topics` array). The dialogue layer writes slugs ('the-steward-of-the-count' — 313 topic ids and ALL of hooks.json's entry_topics AddTopic edges). Nothing folded them. MEASURED BEFORE THE FIX: 74 of 76 `opens_by.topic` values could not be satisfied by any AddTopic edge the machine can fire, 63 of them pure slug-vs-prose spellings; and 47 distinct topic ids sat in NPC `topics` arrays with no reachable info. It was invisible because EVERY quest tool seeds the gate with the quest's own `opens_by.topic` string (tools/quests/mainline-trace.mjs, tools/harness/mag-quest.mjs, harness/api.js seedTopic) — seeding the exact string the gate is about to ask for passes whatever the edges say. Fixed in game/src/core/topics.js (topicKey/sameTopic/topicsInclude), consumed by converse.js buildTopicIndex/infoFor/lineKey and by sim/quest/gate.js canOffer.

`d` (disposition >= N, RI-DLG01 filter field 10) was authored across the dialogue corpus and READ BY NOTHING. tools/dialogue/build-graph.mjs counts it as a filter for the unreachable-INFO lint while converse.js infoAllowed ignored it, so every disposition band in the dialogue data was decorative. Now read, and only when the caller supplies a disposition, so old probe call sites are unchanged.

converse.js infoAllowed now also reads requires.knows (any-of), requires.knows_all (all-of) and forbids.knows against the LIVE sim.quest.flags set, supplied by engine._talkPlayer()/_knownFlags(). A knowledge gate with no context supplied CLOSES rather than opens (RI-JRN07 M-Q14).
engine.listNPCs().topics_offered now computes with the per-NPC derived disposition, so the listed surface and what talkTo() actually offers are the same list.

RG-DEEP derived dispositions on base 50, measured live: interior Saxhleel 74, interior Naga 66, lukiul Saxhleel 48, blackrose Khajiit 36, foreign-born Nord 30, foreign-born Imperial 24, interior Dunmer 20, lukiul Nord 18, lukiul Imperial 12, foreign-born Dunmer 6, lukiul Dunmer 0. res_press_him_on_the_clause's `requires: {disposition: 20}` therefore lands exactly on the interior/lukiul Dunmer split (26 points).

tools/dialogue/build-graph.mjs CANNOT RUN on the current tree and has not been able to for some time — it throws `duplicate topic id 'the-marsh-fever' (40-race-gated.json and earlier)` before it reaches any lint. Pre-existing, not introduced here; main-quest-argument.json introduces no duplicate id.
tools/dialogue/voice-metrics.mjs is cited by game/data/dialogue/speakers.json and reports/W1-17-measurements.md and DOES NOT EXIST.
game/data/books/ total is 1,930 words across 2 files; a third file (the-drowned-tally.json) was added by a concurrent agent during this session, so the library is already being worked.

THE LIBRARY IS TAKEN. A concurrent W1-LIBRARY agent took game/data/books/ from 1,930 words / 2 files to 33,378 words / 57 books during this session, including the two incompatible accounts of the reservoir that mainline.json UA-02 depends on. I did not touch it; I linked to it instead — both d60 answers to `the-count-itself` carry an AddTopic edge to `the-house-under-the-wastes`.
next_step: none — a fresh-context critic should re-measure LH6/LH7/LH8 against the running build, and separately audit the core/topics.js fold, which changes what the quest offer gate accepts across the whole game.
notes_for_successor: The twelve topic ids are slug form in the data file and prose form on the NPC record; core/topics.js folds them so both spellings resolve. Do NOT normalise one side away — 76 quest files and 313 dialogue records disagree and the fold is what lets them coexist. tools/dialogue/build-graph.mjs still cannot run (pre-existing duplicate id 'the-marsh-fever' in 40-race-gated.json) and tools/dialogue/voice-metrics.mjs, which speakers.json cites, does not exist.
